author: Home Repair Tutor
description: I’m installing a HoldRite Fixture Outlet Box using SharkBite PEX Press fittings. This has the shutoff valve integrated with PEX A. These PEX Press fittings can be used with a manual or battery operated tool. They can also be used with PEX A or PEX B.
